name: the Siltwharf Steps
description: A long flight of weathered stone stairs descending from the lower districts to a muddy tidewater wharf, slick with river-silt and loud with gulls. Fisherfolk and smugglers share the lower landings, and a half-sunk barge serves as an impromptu tavern at the waterline. The Steps are the quickest way down to the boats for anyone who would rather not pass the toll-gates, which makes them a favorite of those with reasons to avoid the watch.
